entities.name: Albertina Carlsson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albertina Carlsson was a Swedish zoologist and teacher. She is referred to as the first Swedish woman to have performed scientific studies in zoology. She was awarded an honorary doctorate by Stockholm University in 1927.
